items: Better Mice: Prize mice now show catch history and cooldown status, and the Prize History page has been updated
Better UI: The Team page shows member journals outside of tournaments and visual trap setups
Better Journal: Items mentioned in entries are now linked, and inline loot (like the Polar Vortex Trap) is shown as a list
Better Quests: The M400 helper now supports the Bait Research assignment
Better Inventory: Trap sort and filter controls now match the game's style, show how many items match, and have a Reset link
Location Catch Stats: Added a refresh button
Quick Filters and Sort: Cheese can now be sorted by quantity
Better Maps: Fixed the mouse info popup getting stuck over the mice list
Better Maps: Claiming a consolation prize now asks you to confirm, since it can't be undone
Table of Contents: The simulator now counts the Gold Foil Printing upgrade when estimating Gnawbels
